text_block_list.text:
Even the very moment her debut race came 
to an end, Agnes Tachyon remained 
unchanged, putting research above racing 
first and foremost.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My research has hit a critical point. I 
must head back right away.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: And so, I'll be taking my leave.

However, her running on the racecourse was 
truly overflowing with exceptional talent—
choice_data_list:
(She has the talent to reach the very 
top!)

text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown isn't just a 
dream. She only just debuted, but setting 
it as our goal shouldn't be an issue.

Centering around the Satsuki Sho in April, 
the Japan Derby in May, and the Kikuka Sho 
in Octoberâ

Before I knew it, I was completely 
engrossed, putting together a full 3-year 
racing plan within that very day.

The next morning. Clutching the completed 
rotation plan in hand, I was searching 
around for Agnes Tachyon when—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That's why I've told you time and again, I 
won't participate in your experiments 
anymore—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, don't say that! Aren't we good 
friends, you and I?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I don't recall ever becoming close with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! I thought that as fellow misfits, 
you and I understood each other... Or 
maybe not. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
“And here I thought we got along pretty 
well?!”
In the empty classroom, Manhattan Cafeâ

(She's a mysterious Umamusume who 
supposedly enrolled just to catch up to an 
unseen "friend".)

—...I spotted Agnes Tachyon creeping 
closer and closer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't Trainer-kun! Sorry, but my 
hands are full at the moment.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No, don't worry about it. I'll be on my 
way...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ah! It got away! We were so close, too!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Well, whatever. What's the matter, 
Trainer-kun?
choice_data_list:
There's something important I need to tell 
you!

There's something important I need to tell 
you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"An important discussion, I see. I don't 
mind hearing you out, but keep it brief."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hold on. I take back what I just 
said. Tell me everything in detail. And 
above all else—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Are you alright!? You're completely out of 
breath! This is terrible, drink some water 
and catch your breath!

While feeling unsettled by her 
ever-changing demeanor, I took a sip of 
water—

I moved on to explaining the race rotation 
I had mapped out.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Looking ahead to running in the 
Satsuki Sho, Tokyo Yushun (Japanese 
Derby), and Kikuka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
So our first target race is the Yayoi Sho, 
huh? I see...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Still, aiming for the Classic Triple 
Crown! Aren't we ambitious?

She listened to the whole story, but she 
still seemed somewhat unenthusiastic.
choice_data_list: For you, it's not just a dream!
With you, it's not just a dream!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you're free to get your hopes up. I 
won't deny you that, you know?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I think this rotation matches the future 
you've envisioned, too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Aiming for it is fine. However, I cannot 
promise you will run in these exact 
races."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Whether I enter or not is up to me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My primary objective is research, after 
all! I have no time to waste on trivial 
matters.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—By the way, how are you feeling right 
now?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My hair literally just turned light blue, 
though.

In the end, we were so distracted by the 
light blue hair that day that the 
discussion about the rotation fell by the 
wayside.

Her carefree, whimsical ways remained 
unchanged, and even afterwards—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...That person has been standing alone 
since this morning, what are they doing?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Who knows...? Maybe they're someone's 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...You're here today too, huh.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Seriously, what is she doing...? Creepy.

Days went by without Agnes Tachyon showing 
up for training.

The day I scouted her, I certainly called 
out with high hopes for her future. But 
now—

To begin with, she wasn't particularly 
enthusiastic about the Twinkle Series.

I only decided to make my debut to pursue 
speed, that is all.

“—The sun will set soon. The gazes from 
the other Umamusume sting. Just as I let 
out a sigh and started to head back—”

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! Wait up, Guinea Pig-kun! Don't give 
up! We're running today!
choice_data_list:
Tachyon...! Where have you been all this 
time—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"The sample is finally complete! I want to 
time it as soon as possible!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"You have your stopwatch, right? I'm 
counting on you!"

No sooner had she said that than she 
sprinted off. Reflexively, I hit the 
button on my stopwatch.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: *Haah*... *haah*...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...Hahahaha! Fear not! Faster, go even 
faster!!"

The sight of her tearing across the track 
with wild abandon was, as expected, 
frenzied, yet somehow fleeting—

It overlapped with how she looked on the 
day I decided to scout her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
'What is the limit of the potential 
sleeping in an Uma Musume's legs! What is 
the maximum speed this body can reach!'

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"‘Because they're so far ahead, I can't 
even see their shadows yet...!!’"

—For a while after that, I held my breath 
and watched as she sprinted under the glow 
of the setting sun.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

Her lap time broke records across every 
single split.
...And looking over at her...
She was vigorously spraying her legs.
(Pssssshhhhhhh...!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Kukuku! Not bad if I do say so myself! Far 
from not bad, this is a magnificent 
masterpiece!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Whew, pulling that all-nighter was totally 
worth it! The prototype is finally 
complete! What a great start!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's cold spray. What's with you? You're a 
Trainer, aren't you? Are you a fake or 
something?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you want to grow taller, you take in 
protein and calcium, right? It's the same 
principle.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"More importantly, I made this for next 
year. Show a little more appreciation, 
will you?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Aren't you aiming for the Classic 
races?

"I thought for sure she had no interest... 
but it seems I was sorely mistaken."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, I mean, who knows how things will 
actually turn out, though!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"It's just, I don't think it's a bad idea 
either. ...Though I can't make any 
promises."

—In the training sessions that followed, 
she came and went, and the days of being 
tossed about by her whims continued, but—

"Even so, it seemed I had successfully 
established the Classic races as 
'something to strive for.'"
